Figure 5: HiFi-GAN decoder architecture (Stage 2). Quantized features z, are upsampled through a bottleneck Conv1D followed by 5 decoder blocks. Each block contains ConvTransposelD upsampling and MRF residual blocks with different kernel sizes (3, 7, 11, 15, 23, 32) to capture multi-scale temporal patterns. SnakeBeta activations provide periodic inductive bias for high-fidelity audio generation |Ziyin et al., 2020].
